title: Liberalizing Home-Based Business
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The treatment is treat_post = treat (industry eligible for Singapore's Home Office Scheme, in a propensity-score-matched industry sample) x post (registration quarter >= 2002Q1). post1 (2002Q1-2003Q2) and post2 (2003Q3 onward) are two post-period bins for the same treated industries, not separate adoption cohorts, and the event-study (Figure 2) is dated relative to the single event quarter 2002Q1 (event_qdate = qofd(mdy(1,1,2002))). Firm-level analyses (Tables 7-9) are cross-sectional registrations with industry and registration-month FE or Cox hazard models. Data are proprietary (ACRA registry) and not shipped.
design_notes: Industry (ssic_2) x district x quarter (regitimeqtr) aggregates, Jan 1999 - Mar 2005, 40,600 observations, 58 industry clusters, 25 quarters (analysis_industry.log). Table 2 (analysis_industry.do lines 78-93): reghdfe logfirmno treat_post [aweight=ind_size], a(ssic_2 regitimeqtr year##district) vce(cluster ssic_2 regitimeqtr); col 1 adds treat_pre (2001 anticipation), cols 3-4 add gdpgrowth delta_valueadd and their treat interactions, cols 5-7 split post into post1/post2. Figure 2: treat_preq2..9 / treat_postq0..8 relative-quarter dummies (binned at -9/+8) plus post, same FE and weights. Tables 3-6: triple interactions with firm size, novice/experienced, capital, income, gender. Table 7/9: reghdfe d_secondbiz firbiz_post_post, absorb(ssic_2 reg_month [postcode_2]) on firm registrations; Table 8: stcox treat_post with month, postcode and industry dummies on a matched sample, plus OLS survival dummies with controls.
estimators_reported: twfe_static_common_timing_weighted (industry FE, quarter FE, year x district FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One reform date (2002Q1) for all treated industries; post1/post2 are post-period bins of the same treatment.

specs.treatment_definition: treat (HOS-eligible industry, PSM-matched sample) x post (regitimeqtr >= 20021)
specs.controls: none in col 2; gdpgrowth delta_valueadd (+ treat interactions) in cols 3-4
specs.reported_location: Table 2, column 2 (col 1 adds treat_pre; cols 5-7 use treat_post1 treat_post2)

specs.treatment_definition: relative quarters to 2002Q1 interacted with treat, binned at -9 and +8, -1 omitted

data_files_note: DataDisclosure.docx: ACRA business registry and personal demographic data are confidential; analysis files (ind_month_agg, ind_qtr_dis_agg, ind_qtr_dis_size_agg, ind_qtr_dis_exp*_agg, ind_qtr_dis_female_agg, firbiz_fail, firmlevel_summary, venture_ext, venture_int) are stored at HKU for on-site replication only. Stata logs (analysis_industry.log, analysis_firm.log) are shipped.
software_notes: Stata 17 (reghdfe, stcox, outreg2); Python 3.7 notebook for Figures 1-3.
priority_note: Not eligible (single reform date); data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Treatment timing confirmed from post/post1/post2 definitions (analysis_industry.do lines 61-68) and the Figure 2 event date (line 104).
